proposals.premise: Grocery click-and-collect and appointment booking connect a known choice to availability, then a collection time. Map product or service to tool, stock to availability, and slot to staffed collection.
proposals.opening: Desktop opens with four status rows beside pickup information: two irons available, camera due Thursday, and multimeter for supervised-bench use only. Phone stacks the rows before pickup details.
proposals.move: Request on an available row opens three-day terms, required free iron induction, and Tuesday 18–20 or Saturday 10–14 choices. The eligible item and collection window are confirmed there.
proposals.tradeoff: Availability and pickup are immediately scannable, but members who do not know a tool’s name must read each suitability description.

proposals.premise: Bus planning and recipe finding start with a destination or intended dish, not a route number or recipe title. Map the member’s attempted task to that intent, then reveal suitable tools.
proposals.opening: Desktop opens with a task prompt sharing space with collection times. Phone shows the prompt first; task-based results then show suitability, availability, and pickup information together.
proposals.move: The first control selects the attempted task. Results appear below it; requesting an available match adds three-day terms, iron induction when required, and a staffed collection window before confirmation.
proposals.tradeoff: Beginners avoid guessing names, but knowledgeable members take an extra step. The damaged multimeter can appear as supervised-bench guidance, without a loan control.
